#### 2. Summary of Modifications

1. [test_void_barrier_telemetry_1010.py](file:///C:/Users/Rita/Desktop/caleb/world_simulator/tests/test_void_barrier_telemetry_1010.py)
   - **Removed pytest dependency**: Eliminated `import pytest` and converted all tests into [`unittest.TestCase`](file:///C:/Users/Rita/Desktop/caleb/world_simulator/tests/test_void_barrier_telemetry_1010.py#L73) classes. No third-party test runners, decorators, or fixtures are used.
   - **Full lifecycle isolation**: Added [`setUp()`](file:///C:/Users/Rita/Desktop/caleb/world_simulator/tests/test_void_barrier_telemetry_1010.py#L406-L462) and [`tearDown()`](file:///C:/Users/Rita/Desktop/caleb/world_simulator/tests/test_void_barrier_telemetry_1010.py#L463-L470) to isolate environment variables (`os.environ["EDEN_WINDOW"]`), reset `MAP_CONTRACTS`, close WindowManager services, and reset engine simulation state.
   - **Real movement path integration tests** ([`TestEngineMovementPathIntegration`](file:///C:/Users/Rita/Desktop/caleb/world_simulator/tests/test_void_barrier_telemetry_1010.py#L392-L565)): Replaced direct fake counter calls with tests exercising the real [`Engine.step()`](file:///C:/Users/Rita/Desktop/caleb/world_simulator/at_the_beginning/map_test.py#L4935) reconcile loop and [`WindowManager`](file:///C:/Users/Rita/Desktop/caleb/world_simulator/at_the_beginning/harness/window_manager.py#L91):
     - Unobstructed movement through `Engine.step()` produces zero hits.
     - Autonomous resident vs controlled player hit attribution correctly separates `void_hits_resident` and `void_hits_player` via real `engine.player_control` sessions and `controlled_slots()`.
     - Stale / stationary actors standing against void barriers trigger zero hits across subsequent ticks.
     - Teleportation via `engine._tick_teleports` to standable void boundaries produces zero hits.
     - Moving away from void barriers produces zero hits.
     - Multi-barrier corner collision produces once-per-attempt accounting (incrementing `void_hits` once, not twice).

2. [spatial.py](file:///C:/Users/Rita/Desktop/caleb/world_simulator/at_the_beginning/systems/movement/spatial.py)
   - **Window contract attachment**: Updated [`_window_part(engine)`](file:///C:/Users/Rita/Desktop/caleb/world_simulator/at_the_beginning/systems/movement/spatial.py#L48-L53) to attach `_window_contract` when `window_enabled()` is true or when an engine has an explicit `_window` attached. Legacy maps without window managers remain unaffected.
   - **Stationary non-displacement guard**: Added an exact check in [`slide`](file:///C:/Users/Rita/Desktop/caleb/world_simulator/at_the_beginning/systems/movement/spatial.py#L267-L279) for stationary attempts (`desired == start`) within bounds, returning `(nx, ny)` with zero collision flags (`void_hit=False`, `wall_hit=False`, `blocked=False`).
   - **Diagnostic deduplication**: Deduplicated contact box IDs in `void_boxes` and `wall_boxes` while preserving insertion order.

3. [map_test.py](file:///C:/Users/Rita/Desktop/caleb/world_simulator/at_the_beginning/map_test.py) (Narrow Movement Enforcement)
   - **Stationary & teleport guard**: In [`Engine.step()`](file:///C:/Users/Rita/Desktop/caleb/world_simulator/at_the_beginning/map_test.py#L5004-L5028), living residents with `start == desired` (idle actors, stale movement intents, or teleported actors arriving on that tick) bypass collision recording, preventing false-positive telemetry while preserving exact coordinates.
   - **Window resolution**: Allowed attached window manager on `self._window` to be reconciled whether `window_wire.window_enabled()` was pre-initialized or dynamically attached in tests.

4. [window_manager.py](file:///C:/Users/Rita/Desktop/caleb/world_simulator/at_the_beginning/harness/window_manager.py)
   - Verified authoritative counter methods ([`record_void_hit`](file:///C:/Users/Rita/Desktop/caleb/world_simulator/at_the_beginning/harness/window_manager.py#L491-L498), [`record_wall_hit`](file:///C:/Users/Rita/Desktop/caleb/world_simulator/at_the_beginning/harness/window_manager.py#L499-L506), [`reset_counters`](file:///C:/Users/Rita/Desktop/caleb/world_simulator/at_the_beginning/harness/window_manager.py#L512-L514), and properties) and confirmed that origin rebase maintains counter continuity in `stats()`.
